# Compile N Run

> > Free online platform for learning and practicing programming languages with interactive code compilation and execution.

Compile N Run provides comprehensive documentation and tutorials for beginners and intermediate programmers across 10+ programming languages including Python, Java, JavaScript, C, C++, and more. The platform covers both language fundamentals and core computer science concepts through structured learning guides.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Java
- JavaScript
- C
- C++
- SQL
- TypeScript
- Go
- Rust
- Web Development
- Algorithms
- Databases
- Operating Systems
- Networks
- Interview Preparation

## Programming Languages

- [Python Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/python): Python language overview covering history, features, and basic syntax
- [Java Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/java): Comprehensive Java introduction with history, features, and applications
- [JavaScript Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/javascript): JavaScript fundamentals for web development with HTML, CSS integration
- [C Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/c): C language history, features, and fundamentals for systems programming
- [C++ Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/cpp): C++ language guide covering syntax, data types, and programming basics
- [SQL Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/sql): SQL fundamentals for relational databases and database communication
- [TypeScript Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/typescript): TypeScript setup guide covering static typing and JavaScript superset basics
- [Go Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/go): Go language introduction with setup, features, and basic syntax tutorial
- [C# Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/c-sharp): C# programming guide covering .NET framework and environment setup
- [Rust Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/rust): Rust language introduction with memory safety and systems programming focus

## Computer Science Fundamentals

- [Algorithm Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/fundamental/algorithm): Beginner guide to algorithms, efficiency, and problem-solving fundamentals
- [Introduction to Databases](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/fundamental/database): Database fundamentals covering MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and relational DBs
- [Operating System Fundamentals](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/fundamental/os): OS concepts, resource management, and core functions across Windows, Linux
- [Networks Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/fundamental/network): Introduction to computer networks, topologies, and networking fundamentals

## Frameworks & Tools

- [.NET Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/framework/dotnet): .NET framework guide with C#, F#, and cross-platform development basics

## Career & Interview Preparation

- [Interview Types](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/fundamental/interview): Guide to technical interview types and preparation for programming careers

## Optional

- [PHP Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/php): PHP server-side scripting guide with setup and web development basics
- [Kotlin Introduction](https://www.compilenrun.com/docs/language/kotlin): Kotlin language guide for JVM and Android development fundamentals
